$comment: Machine-readable manifest of the reference repos analysed in specs/. They are NOT vendored in this repo (3 of 8 carry no licence). Clone with scripts/setup-reference.sh, or read this manifest and clone yourself. Every spec cites file:line against these exact clone strategies.

repos.licence: CC0 (asserted in README; no LICENSE file — attribute explicitly)
repos.why: 83 real Namma Metro stations: coordinates, directed graph edges, real inter-station distances, interchange flags, line colours. Use the data directly.

repos.licence: NONE DECLARED — read for ideas, do not copy code
repos.why: Working H3 corridor matching: routes encoded as concatenated H3 cells in a lexicographic sorted set, candidates found by prefix range scan. The best algorithm in the set.
Production VRP API schema — skills, breaks, priority, shipments, multi-window tasks, and a `violation` object that is the model for a policy trace. Highest value-per-minute document in the set.
TU Munich ride-pooling fleet simulator. Semi-on-demand feeder services (the literature name for metro-feeder), insertion heuristic, Alonso-Mora RTV pooling, EV charging, fleet sizing.

State-of-the-art VRPTW solver. Its constraint vocabulary (shift_duration, max_distance, capacity vectors, client groups, prizes) maps 1:1 onto an employee-transport policy engine. Also a free bin-packing fleet lower bound.
Constraint-based scoring: named declarative constraints, three-tier hard/medium/soft score, and a load-balancing 'fairness' constraint that is the missing policy for pooling.

repos.licence: NONE DECLARED — read for ideas, do not copy code
repos.why: One 1186-line file with hand-written Dijkstra, Prim's and branch-and-bound TSP. Useful for pickup ordering and an OpenRouteService integration; its MST-as-route-cost is an instructive wrong turn.

repos.licence: NONE DECLARED — read for ideas, do not copy code
repos.why: Reportedly a MoveInSync recruitment assignment. Its matching algorithm is commented out (36% of one controller), so it is calibration data: it shows where a competent candidate runs out of time.

rejected.reason: Claimed 'real-time tracking + optimal allocation logic'. Grep across all of src/ found zero distance, matching or allocation code. Leaflet + Firebase + a 45 MB vendored CometChat UI kit. 53 MB for one dependency insight.

Claimed 'Routing + Admin Panel + Cloud CDK'. Repository contains 6 markdown files and no code; doc/datamodel.md is 0 bytes. The README feature list is an aspirational roadmap for an unstarted project.
